scope: Disposable direct-runtime probe with only the diagnostic extension loaded; no user extensions, skills, or project context.
conclusions: Pi exposes a durable native session UUID and session file.
Model and effective thinking level are authoritative in extension context and RPC state.
Thinking can change live and the runtime emits the effective selected value.
Tool start/end share a stable toolCallId.
turnIndex identifies individual LLM calls inside one process, not a durable user request: it reset to zero after resume.
A new process explicitly resumed with --session still reported session_start reason startup; the matching native session ID, not the reason string, proves resume.
agent_settled is the authoritative no-retry/no-continuation boundary for the observed run.
redactions: Temporary absolute paths were replaced with $TMP.
Prompt text, assistant text, tool arguments/results, cost fields, URLs, and credentials are omitted.
